text:
morgan: Hey folks — PR ready for merge but need specific eyes before I land. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/82021

morgan: Asking runtime for perf signoff, infra for config/ops notes, and security for KMS/auth check. Planning to merge Wed 12:30pm PT if no blockers.

alex: @talia @jen-security assigning runtime + security tags. I can do platform review now.

ci-bot: CI ✅ all checks passing (unit, integration, e2e). build/1234, artifacts uploaded.

talia: I'll take a look at the perf numbers today. quick heads-up: this changes the batching default; I'd like to see a 1k request/second smoke run.

sam: Noted — I can spin the smoke load on staging, ping me when the branch is deployed to staging.

morgan: Deploy to staging is done: `staging/runtime/82021` image pushed. sam, link to job: https://ci.redwood/1234/staging-deploy

jen-security: Quick read-through: need to confirm KMS key usage and audit logs preservation. If the PR sets `USE_CUSTOM_KMS=true` we need the key ARN in the rollout doc. Can @alex add the ARN or mark as runtime-managed?

alex: PLATFORM side: we keep `USE_CUSTOM_KMS=false` by default. If security wants explicit ARN in the docs I can add it in a follow-up, but won't block merge.

talia: Perf quick notes after a 5m run: p95 token latency +1.8% under 512 tokens, throughput unchanged. I'll run the 1k RPS smoke tomorrow morning and post results.

sam: Started the smoke job now, will post logs here when done.

alex: I left one tiny comment about a logging key rename — non-blocking.

morgan: Updated PR with platform logging rename and added a short section in the rollout doc about KMS defaults.

jen-security: Thanks. I still want the audit-log line in the rollout doc, but that can be a doc-only follow-up. Security not blocking for now. :white_check_mark:

talia: If perf smoke passes (expected), I'm fine with runtime signoff.

sam: Smoke job finished: staging saw steady 1k RPS for 5m, no OOMs, error rate 0.2% (expected for warmup). Logs: https://ci.redwood/1234/smoke/logs

morgan: Great — with that, status: platform done (alex), runtime tentative (talia), infra ops review ok (sam), security non-blocking (jen-security). Intend to merge Wed 12:30pm PT unless someone objects before then.

alex: LGTM from platform side. :thumbsup:

talia: Runtime signoff pending one more long-run, but OK to proceed if we want canary first.

morgan: Plan: canary 10% traffic for 30m then full rollout. Will file canary playbook + rollback steps in PR.

jen-security: Please add the audit-log note to the canary playbook before rollout.

morgan: Will do. thanks all.

alex: cc: @infra-team @runtime-team for visibility.

morgan: Closing loop — I'll merge on Wed 12:30pm PT assuming no new issues. If anything pops up, reply here or @morgan.
